title: Payments R12: `openagents.com/stats` page
body:
Design: [central receive and splits, section 7, "Surfaces"](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/payments/2026-10-02-central-receive-and-splits.md#surfaces). Depends on #10195.

## Do
- A server-rendered page in `crates/openagents-web/src/pages/` reading `/api/stats`: totals received and paid out, pending accruals, a table of plugins (calls, earned), a table of authors (paid out), 24 h and 30 d series, the reconciliation state, the time of the last event. Link to `/live`.
- No new script beyond `script-src 'self'`; it works with JavaScript off.
- Tests in `crates/openagents-web/src/tests.rs` with a stubbed stats backend.

## Done when
- The page renders from a fixture and links to `/live`.


Size: **Coder-sized** (`openagents chat work --issues coder-sized`).

Part of the central payments plan: https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/payments/2026-10-02-central-receive-and-splits.md
